title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer of approximately 41.3 GeV.

title: Invariant Mass Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the invariant mass equation to relate energies and momenta.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately calculate the total energy in the center-of-mass frame.

title: Mass Energy Relation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may reference the mass-energy equivalence in their explanation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as miscalculating the square root or neglecting the rest mass of protons.
